records.claim: A new developer can use this development checkpoint without an untracked sibling workspace.
records.critique_basis: A shareable checkpoint must close its runtime dependency graph through committed artifacts or a reproducibly obtainable, versioned dependency.
records.invariant: Installing the submitted repository must make newapi-media-client resolvable independently of a private sibling folder.

steps: Create an empty temporary directory whose parent has no AIadapter/media-adapter directory.
Create a package.json with only the exact newapi-media-client dependency value from package.json:16: file:../AIadapter/media-adapter.
Run npm install --offline --ignore-scripts with a temporary cache. Installation may report success because npm creates a dangling local link.
Run the recorded import from that directory. Compare with the same import from the main workspace.

records.observed: Isolated import exits 1 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The declared file dependency points outside the repository and is not supplied by the commit.
records.expected: The dependency resolves from the submitted checkout without relying on the author's existing sibling directory.
records.non_tautology_check: The same import succeeds in the main workspace; a committed package artifact or reproducible dependency would make the isolated import succeed too.
